emails.body:
This email has one purpose: to give you a direct way to put forward a bookkeeping question without guessing what matters to your business.

Ledgerloop is a bookkeeping support service for small businesses. Rather than assume what you need, we’re inviting you to name the question that would help you decide whether to start a conversation.

It could be a question about bookkeeping or about getting bookkeeping support. You can share as much context as you think is relevant, or simply send the question itself.

A reply puts your question directly to Ledgerloop and opens the conversation there.
